profile.headline: Business Owner, Software Dev, Culinary Try Hard
profile.summary:
I am a young professional with large goals in the food technology sector. I have completed multiple degrees to specialize myself to work with other engineers and farmers to innovate current farming, preservation and restaurant operational technology.

I began my career in the food service industry where I for 8 years hardened myself in the principles of what it takes to make a great chef. I hesitate to call myself great because the growth of a chef is never done but I can reflect on my time and say that every bit of it was a humbling learning experience and that the growth I experienced can be clearly seen in my projects and portfolio. This experience has provided me with many raw cooking skills, but also business development, R&D, project and process management , teamwork and leadership skills. After graduating from culinary school I experienced many working environments and have had the opportunity to work in the best restaurants in my city and stage at even greater outside. My culinary experience has also lead to a strong base of independent research. For a period of time I was the food scientist for big dipper cookie dough co. my independent work through that company was based off my tenacity to do more, my creativity in using flavors as well as chemical properties of ingredients to really bend the laws of what most know as baking. While that experience has passed I definitely learned a lot and believe it was a natural step for me before I moved into the world of engineering

I am currently working as a Full stack Software Engineer at Feyen Zylstra. I joined FZ’s digital solutions department because the company was growing the department with goals of creating a strong background in industry 4.0 technologies and was preparing to move into a really huge sector of IIOT development. Due to covid, changes have happened so I have been developing internal apps using frontend/backend and dB technologies for time entry and reporting for nearly 1000 employees. I am thrilled to have a job and I’m thrilled to be working for a great company like FZ. I have learned more than I ever expected and have garnered a new appreciation for the type of work I’m doing and how I’m the large scale it will benefit me. However I am excited to move into a more IOT driven role so I have begun working towards that. I am currently in the process of becoming AWS certified as well as becoming more versed in micro technologies such as API driven machine learning and small scale process automation. I am excited to find what else is out there for me.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Full stack software development including both react and angular front ends, API development in C#, Entity Framework implementations, SQL management and scripting in Python for scheduled data migrations and functions as well as Azure Cloud management for deployments, git, automated scrum management and Active Directory role management.

Initially I was hired in to FZ as an intern. As an intern I worked on a data pipeline software for industry 4.0 factory applications. I was primarily focused on front end development with a few introductions to API development. Since then I have grown dramatically, now speaking directly with users and department heads, planning, developing and supporting features myself. I have been a huge part in developing multiple time entry systems for our company all designed with strong UX focus on desktop and mobile applications as well as a new reporting system to bring the companies reporting from a legacy system and excel work books. I have also developed a user feedback system, a logging system, an internal role system for feature access and role grouping and many tools to streamline supporting developed software. I have grown a lot at FZ and will always remember it fondly

Due to the pandemic my role changed a few times and eventually I ended up working for IT in a remote role. working remotely has definitely pushed me to better time manage and grow as a more independent developer. I believe it has been not only the most challenging element of the pandemic, but also the most effective in my developed confidence and abilities as a software engineer.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Azure DevOps · Scrum · TypeScript · AngularJS · Microsoft SQL Server · Agile Methodologies · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · C# · Entity Framework

positions.title: Software engineering intern
positions.description:
Full stack software engineering internship in the IIOT branch of the company.This internship was focused on developing Endeavor, an industry 4.0 data aggregation web app. Endeavor collects data from many different platforms including (PLC's, user inputs, DB's) and allows the user to decide what to do with the info (altering, filtering etc) and then creating customized displays of the data or reactions based on custom rules set by the user.

skills gained:
This internship consisted of state heavy react front end development data communication, SQL database work, C# based backend development using Microsoft Orleans as a framework, microsoft azure hosting and lots of software architectural planning for new tools and UI elements implemented into the platform

volunteerExperiences.description:
Food sorting and quality control for large scale food waste product. Trucks full of waste food would show up and myself along with other volunteers would sort through it to find anything that was still edible. After being sorted all fresh foods would be cleaned and repackaged for distribution.

this was my first unofficial job. I learned the importance of doing simple tasks and the rewards that they provided. in this case to many hungry people. I worked nearly 500 hours over the 3 summers for this corporation and if I had the time now I would go back and volunteer more.

City High school required all students volunteer 40 hours every summer. I spent over 150 hours at this organization every summer working. I began to love the people and I loved the concept of doing something to reclaim lost food and give it to people who could not afford to stock their own refrigerators. while initially I never had the desire to do anything with food I believe this sparked my interest in the food industry and my interest to never waste food or otherwise.

volunteerExperience.description:
Food sorting and quality control for large scale food waste product. Trucks full of waste food would show up and myself along with other volunteers would sort through it to find anything that was still edible. After being sorted all fresh foods would be cleaned and repackaged for distribution.

this was my first unofficial job. I learned the importance of doing simple tasks and the rewards that they provided. in this case to many hungry people. I worked nearly 500 hours over the 3 summers for this corporation and if I had the time now I would go back and volunteer more.

City High school required all students volunteer 40 hours every summer. I spent over 150 hours at this organization every summer working. I began to love the people and I loved the concept of doing something to reclaim lost food and give it to people who could not afford to stock their own refrigerators. while initially I never had the desire to do anything with food I believe this sparked my interest in the food industry and my interest to never waste food or otherwise.
